product.name: Velara Workspace 3-in-1
product.description: The Velara Workspace 3-in-1 Desk Organizer is engineered to streamline office environments with a modular design that accommodates pens, notebooks, and electronic accessories. Constructed from high‑density recycled cardboard and a protective paper lining, the unit measures 45 cm in length, 20 cm in width, and 10 cm in depth, providing ample storage while maintaining a slim profile. Three adjustable trays allow users to customize the space for writing instruments, small documents, or a tablet. The charcoal finish offers a professional aesthetic that blends seamlessly with contemporary office décor. Designed for durability, the organizer is easy to assemble and disassemble, making it suitable for both permanent and temporary workspaces.
